blocks.text: Dispatch currently tracks vehicle location, driver activity, and delivery status through phone calls, WhatsApp updates, and manually maintained spreadsheets. As the fleet has grown, this no longer scales to real dispatch and safety needs.

items: Dispatchers have no live view of the fleet and must call drivers to confirm status.
Vehicles that leave approved routes or restricted zones go unnoticed until a customer or driver reports it.
Driver performance — on-time delivery, harsh braking, idle time — isn't tracked, so coaching relies on anecdote.
Incident response is delayed 15–30 minutes on average while dispatch locates the affected vehicle manually.
Higher fuel and maintenance cost from unmonitored idling and route deviation
Limited visibility for safety and compliance reporting
Dispatcher time spent on manual check-ins instead of exception handling

blocks.text: A centralized monitoring portal that surfaces live vehicle position, automated geofence alerts, and driver performance data lets dispatch manage by exception instead of by phone call — and gives the business a defensible record for safety and compliance.

The Fleet Monitoring Portal is a web application that gives dispatch and operations teams real-time visibility into vehicle location, geofence compliance, and driver performance — replacing manual check-ins with automated tracking and alerts.

items: Give dispatch a live map of the entire active fleet, updated in real time.
Automatically alert the team when a vehicle enters or leaves a defined zone.
Score and surface driver performance so coaching is based on data, not anecdote.

test_cases.title: Live map shows all active vehicles
test_cases.precondition: Logged in as Dispatcher; at least 1 vehicle is transmitting GPS.
steps: Wait for the map to finish loading.
test_cases.expected_result: Map renders within 3 seconds with a marker for every active vehicle at its last known position.

test_cases.title: Map updates vehicle position in real time
test_cases.precondition: Live map open with at least one moving vehicle.
steps: Note a vehicle's current marker position.
Wait 30 seconds without refreshing the page.
test_cases.expected_result: The marker moves to the vehicle's updated position without a manual page refresh.

test_cases.title: Geofence breach triggers an alert
test_cases.precondition: A geofence zone is configured; a vehicle assigned to it is active.
steps: Move (or simulate) the vehicle outside the defined zone.
test_cases.expected_result: An alert appears within 60 seconds naming the vehicle, the zone, and the breach time.

test_cases.title: No false alert while inside the zone
test_cases.precondition: Vehicle remains within its assigned geofence for the full session.
steps: Monitor the vehicle for 10 minutes inside the zone.

test_cases.title: Driver scorecard reflects latest trip data
test_cases.precondition: Driver has completed at least one trip since the last scorecard refresh.
steps: Compare trip count and on-time percentage to the raw trip logs.
test_cases.expected_result: Scorecard numbers match the underlying trip data exactly.

test_cases.title: Empty state when no vehicles are transmitting
test_cases.precondition: No vehicles are currently sending GPS data (e.g. a fresh demo account).
steps: Open the Live Map with zero active vehicles.
test_cases.expected_result: The map shows a clear empty-state message instead of a blank map, with no console errors.
